content:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a 95p latency jump for shared-gpu-pool-C starting ~12:15 UTC. Small-chat workloads spike from ~120ms -> ~620ms. Seems correlated with a heavy tenant burst.
kevin: I pulled traces — kernel_autoswitch count up ~4x vs baseline. KV cache hitrate fell to ~38%. From logs: `kv_cache: miss=624 load_ms=42` around 12:16.
sasha: Adding perf traces now. If KV loads exceed ~20ms runtime falls back to full-kernel path which explains the jump. Can someone grab pprof from the hot GPU pod?
jun: Running pprof now. Top shows memcpy and kernel selector hot:
```
# top functions
memcpy: 1500ns
kernel_selector: 42% CPU
kv_load_blocking: 28% CPU
```
Also observed batch sizes collapse to 1 frequently (tail latency causing immediate flush).
deploy-bot: autoscaler: evicted pods: 2 pods evicted in pool-C at 12:17 UTC due to memory pressure (reason: kv-load spikes).
maya: Summary hypothesis: noisy tenant -> KV thrash -> cache misses -> kernel flip -> batch collapse -> high latency. Needs short-term throttle + medium-term runtime mitigations.
kevin: Quick mitigation we can do now: throttle tenant-xyz on pool-C to 30rps and add a KV load SLO alarm at 15ms. Who can do the quota change?
sasha: I'll prototype a kernel-selection hysteresis: require 3 consecutive windows of elevated miss latency before switching to the full kernel path. Branch: `runtime/kv-hysteresis`. Will open PR.
jun: I'll run a replay with synthetic KV-thrash and the hysteresis patch. Script: `scripts/repro_kv_thrash.sh` (runs 60s ramp, 200 rps burst). Will upload flame graphs.
maya: Action items: Kevin — apply quota to tenant-xyz; Sasha — open PR and run e2e; Jun — run replay and share flame; I'll notify customer-ops and keep monitoring. ETA ~2h.
kevin: Applied throttle to tenant-xyz on pool-C at 12:40 UTC :white_check_mark: (quotaId: q-34c1). Also added KV p95 alarm at 15ms in alerts config.
sasha: PR opened (#887). Unit perf tests look neutral; need e2e run against shared pool. Patch adds simple hysteresis + metrics (`runtime.kv.hysteresis_hits`).
jun: Replay complete. With throttle + hysteresis: p95 fell to ~140ms. KV p95 load_ms=9.2ms. Flame: https://perf.internal/redwood/flame/196543/rep1 (uploaded).
maya: Great. We'll keep the throttle for 24h while we bake the patch and schedule permanent per-tenant soft-limits + better KV backoff. I'll create an incident ticket and link notes.
kevin: Recommend follow-ups: 1) telemetry: per-tenant kv_load_ms histograms, 2) runtime: kernel-selection cooldown, 3) quota autoscale: better reactive throttles for noisy tenants.
sasha: I'll include unit+e2e benchmarks in PR and add an opt-in flag for canary.
jun: Leaving notes in the replay script about how to reproduce with `--seed 42`.
maya: Thanks all. Monitoring dashboard for pool-C updated and pinned. Will post incident ticket shortly. :thumbsup:
